## Hypothesis

We are trying to capture edge by tightening sniper entry filters (vol_mult, body_min_cents, min_stars, proximity_dollars) and adjusting exit parameters (premium stop, TP1, profit lock) to improve win rate and reduce losses on J loser days. However, the negative edge_capture suggests the changes may have overfit to non-J days or degraded performance on structurally important J winner days.

## Mechanism

Entry: Requires volume >= vol_mult * 20-bar avg, candle body >= body_min_cents, min_stars >= 2, strike_offset = 2 (OTM-2), proximity to break level <= proximity_dollars, and require_break_above_open = true. Exit: premium stop at -10% (catastrophe cap), TP1 at +50% with 50% quantity fraction, runner target at 200% of entry premium, profit lock arms at +5% profit with 5% stop offset.
